Heard learned Counsel for the petitioners.
It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that samples were taken way back in the year 2011.
At that time, the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act had already been repealed by Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and as such the proceedings initiated under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act are illegal.
In similar matters, Court has passed stay orders.
